Enter the name of the local variable that contains the network portion of the object reference that this shape is to bind to. Enter <none> if you do not wish to use a network alias. If set, the bound reference is the concatenation of the value of network alias variable, the value of the system alias variable (if set) and the object reference property.

Enter the name of the local variable that contains the system portion of the object reference that shapes on the page are to bind to. Enter <none> if you do not wish to use a system alias. v:ud.v:val: VT4(SVG <script><![CDATA[function fixtext(target) {var tb = target;var bb = tb.getBBox();var children = tb.getChildNodes();for (child_idx=0; child_idx < children.length; child_idx++){if (children.item(child_idx).nodeName() == 'text'){var thetext = children.item(child_idx);textchildren = thetext.getChildNodes;for(textchild_idx=0; textchildren.length; textchild_idx++){if (textchildren.item(textchild_idx).nodeName() == 'v:paragraph'){switch(textchildren.item(textchild_idx).getAttribute('v:horizAlign')){case '1': var text_start = parseFloat(thetext.getAttribute('x'));var text_width = thetext.getComputedTextLength();text_start += text_width / 2;thetext.setAttribute('x', text_start);thetext.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');break;case '2': var text_width = thetext.getComputedTextLength();var text_start = parseFloat(thetext.getAttribute('x'));text_start += text_width;thetext.setAttribute('x', text_start);thetext.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');break;default: break;}break;}}break;}}}]]></script>)
